response.text:
Timro invoice ma **late fee ko kura lekheko chaina** — invoice ma due date (2026-10-31, 21 din baki) ra amount AUD 6,500 matra cha. Late fee kati lagcha bhanne kura university ko policy ma huncha, invoice ma chaina — tyo ma sanga thaha hudaina, university lai sodhnu parcha.

Aaja NPR 25,000 pathaune kura:
- **Rate**: NPR→AUD mid rate 0.009289 (as of 2026-10-09) → NPR 25,000 ≈ **AUD 232.23**
- **Friday samma Sydney ma pugcha ki?** Ma pakka bhana sakdina. NPR→AUD corridor ma **kunai active provider bhetiyena**, so aaja pathaune transfer nai garna milena. Date ra rate "pakka" bhanne guarantee dina sakdina — rate din-din ma badlincha.

Note: NPR 25,000 le AUD 232 matra huncha, tuition ko AUD 6,500 ko lagi dherai thorai ho. Tuition tirna khojeko ho bhane tyo amount le pugdaina.

Ke garne bhanne? Ma NPR→AUD provider chaina bhane, timro AUD account (AUD 4,200 + 1,500 savings) bata sidhai university lai tirna sakchu — tyo chai aaja nai jaancha. Bhan, garam?
